Run a unified, QC-linked aquatic scientific research analysis

Source: R/research-analysis-workflows.R
aqt_research_analyze.Rd

Uses the source-preserving Milestone 02 review as the ONLY eligible measurement source. No timestamps, fish identities, tank assignments or physical calibration are fabricated. Profiles whose evidentiary conditions are not satisfied are marked skipped/blocked with explicit diagnostics. Event clock equivalence must be researcher-declared. Population-level inference is limited by independently treated tanks, not frame counts.

Usage

aqt_research_analyze(
  review,
  profiles = c("movement", "schooling"),
  events = NULL,
  design = NULL,
  config = list()
)

Arguments

review

Completed aqt_qc_review from aqt_trajectory_qc.

profiles

Any subset of movement, schooling, events, functional, experimental, uncertainty.

events

Optional independent event log (session_id,event_id,start_s,end_s).

design

Optional unique session/camera/tank/treatment mapping.

config

Named analysis settings; see docs/SCIENTIFIC_WORKFLOWS_V1.md.

Value

aqt_scientific_analysis with measurements, diagnostics and original QC lineage. Model failures and unsupported profiles retain exact reasons.
